passage:
In winter, the classroom coat rack was always messy. Jackets fell to the floor, and students often took the wrong ones.
The class leader suggested numbering the hooks. Each student got one number for the semester.
The problem improved quickly. Jackets stayed in place, and students found them faster.
However, one hook remained empty for weeks because its student was absent with a long illness. A classmate placed a small paper heart on the hook. Soon others added messages.
When the student returned, the hook was full of welcome notes.
The coat rack had started as an organization problem. It became a reminder that an empty space can help people remember someone.
